a9547c853cb99749f985d07ee188542fd3f5c001.notes: One row per licence: 3,485 rows, 3,485 distinct licence numbers. There is no postcode column; the district is read from the postcode that ends 'Property Address', found in all 3,485. Never mapped: the holder's and manager's names and addresses, the address itself, Easting, Northing, Longitude, Latitude and Location. The register's own Notice says it is for identifying licensed HMOs and not for marketing, and that nobody named in it consented to that; nothing that names anybody is carried. The Notice also says the maximum persons follows an inspection while rooms and amenities are as the applicant stated, so only the former is mapped. Zero persons and storeys of 0 or 200 appear and are nulled with a note. Dates are day-first. Review: 25 districts, NW1 the largest; two types, two statuses.

11ecd966cf9b568415b7620460ea01741a1c3238.notes: One row per licence: 5,545 rows, 5,545 distinct reference numbers. Three licence types, including 11 '257 HMO' (buildings converted into flats, section 257 of the Housing Act 2004), kept in the publisher's words. Zero occupants or households appear and are nulled with a note. No status column and no as_of in the file. Review: 13 districts, SW4 the largest; dates year-first with a time that is always midnight.

56e1871a28940d20246e5ccd3762504fbd9e10b9.notes: Not a register: Stirling publishes the number of licensed properties at each postcode, one row per postcode (137 postcodes, each once). The district is read from the postcode that ends 'address', found in all 109 (KT4, KT17, KT18, KT19). Never mapped: address, uprn, ogc_fid. 'property_classification' is the address's AddressBase class, not the licence's type, so it is not licence_type. One row has its cells shifted by one; its dates will not read and are left null. Not a register but a log of applications since 2020: 6,523 rows, of which 5,807 granted, for 4,974 distinct licences. Kept: the latest grant of each licence number whose expiry date has not passed on the build day, about 2,490 on 27 Sep 2026. 'LIVING_ACCOMMODATION' is the address; the district is read from the postcode at its end (97.5% have one). 'CATEGORY' (A: up to 10 persons, B: 11 or more) is the only kind the register gives. Never mapped: LICENCE_HOLDER, LETTING_AGENT, the address itself, WARD, SHAPEAREA, SHAPELEN.
